en-US.description:
Flex is Senegal’s first ride-hailing app where YOU name the price.

HOW IT WORKS
1. Set where you are and where you’re going.
2. Offer the amount you want to pay, in CFA francs.
3. Nearby drivers accept, decline, or counter-offer.
4. You choose — on price, arrival time, rating and vehicle.

NO FIXED FARE, NO SURGE
No automatic peak-hour markup. The price is the one you accepted, and nothing is added to it.

WHAT DRIVERS DON’T SEE
Before accepting your ride, a driver sees neither your full name, nor your number, nor your exact position — only an approximate area and a district name. Your saved places carry a name only you can read.

DRIVE WITH FLEX
Submit your documents from the app: ID, driving licence, vehicle registration. Once your file is approved, go online, receive nearby requests, and set your own terms.

COVERAGE
Dakar and its region, plus intercity trips departing from Dakar: Thiès, Mbour, Saly, Touba, Saint-Louis, Kaolack, Ziguinchor.

Flex connects passengers with independent drivers. Flex is not a carrier.
en-US.title: Flex Sénégal
en-US.subtitle: Name your own price

fr-FR.description:
Flex est la première application de transport du Sénégal où c’est VOUS qui dites le prix.

COMMENT ÇA MARCHE
1. Indiquez où vous êtes et où vous allez.
2. Proposez le montant que vous voulez payer, en FCFA.
3. Les chauffeurs proches acceptent, refusent, ou vous proposent un autre prix.
4. Vous choisissez : selon le prix, le délai d’arrivée, la note et le véhicule.

PAS DE TARIF IMPOSÉ, PAS DE MAJORATION
Aucune majoration automatique aux heures de pointe. Le prix est celui que vous avez accepté, et rien d’autre ne s’y ajoute.

CE QUE LES CHAUFFEURS NE VOIENT PAS
Avant d’accepter votre course, un chauffeur ne voit ni votre nom complet, ni votre numéro, ni votre position exacte — seulement une zone approximative et un nom de commune. Vos lieux enregistrés portent un nom que vous seul lisez.

CONDUIRE AVEC FLEX
Déposez vos documents depuis l’application : pièce d’identité, permis, carte grise. Une fois votre dossier validé, passez en ligne, recevez les demandes autour de vous, et fixez vos propres conditions.

ZONE COUVERTE
Dakar et sa région, ainsi que les trajets interurbains au départ de Dakar : Thiès, Mbour, Saly, Touba, Saint-Louis, Kaolack, Ziguinchor.

Flex met en relation des passagers et des chauffeurs indépendants. Flex n’est pas un transporteur.

fr-FR.subtitle: Proposez votre prix

review.notes:
Flex is a ride-hailing app with direct price negotiation, for Senegal.

SIGNING IN
Sign-in is by phone number and a one-time SMS code. Both accounts below are Supabase test numbers: they return a fixed code and send no SMS, so no real phone is needed.

TWO TEST ACCOUNTS — PLEASE USE BOTH
1. PASSENGER   +15550000001   code 123456
2. DRIVER      +15550000002   code 123456   (documents already approved)

The second account is not optional. Becoming a driver requires identity documents approved by a human, so a fresh account can never reach the driver side. Signing in only with the passenger account would make half the app look missing.

TESTING THE PASSENGER SIDE (account 1)
1. The home screen and the place picker are browsable WITHOUT signing in.
2. Pick a departure point and a destination, then set a price.
3. Tap "Envoyer ma proposition" — the app asks you to sign in at that point, then returns you to your filled-in request.

TESTING THE DRIVER SIDE (account 2)
1. Sign in with +15550000002.
2. Open the "Profil" tab.
3. Tap "Passer en mode conducteur" — the driver home appears: full-screen map, today's earnings, and a large GO button.
4. Tapping GO puts the driver online and shows nearby ride requests.
Alternatively, the same driver home is reachable from the "Passer en ligne" shortcut on the passenger home.

ACCOUNT DELETION
Profil > Compte > "Supprimer mon compte", with an explicit confirmation. It is refused while a ride is in progress, with a message saying so.

REPORTING AND BLOCKING
"Signaler" appears on a received review (Profil > Mes avis) and on a completed ride (Profil > Mes courses). Blocking is under Profil > Personnes bloquées.

LANGUAGE
The interface is in French by default. English is available in Profil > Affichage > Langue.

LOCATION
The app asks for location to suggest your pick-up point. Everything works without it; only map centring and going online as a driver are disabled.
